title: Chaos in Klang Valley after downpour | The Star
text:
Chaos in Klang Valley after downpour | The Star
PETALING JAYA: A two hour downpour brought several areas in the Klang Valley to a standstill as flood waters rose and submerged cars and houses.
Motorists going home from their offices were caught in a gridlock after the rain which started at about 3pm. Many were stranded on the road for several hours.
